title: Cabros Bot endpoint latency budgets
description: Per-route p95 latency budgets enforced by tests/helpers/perfBudget.js. The helper tolerates a 1.5x soft envelope (console.warn) and fails at 2x unless PERF_BUDGET_RELAXED=true is set.

p95Ms.description: Documented p95 ceiling for the route in milliseconds.

rationale.description: One-line reason this number is the right budget (e.g. bounded by an env timeout).

_meta.description: Optional metadata; ignored by the helper but documented for reviewers.
